import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from dedupe import dedupe


class DedupeEmptyInputTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_list_returns_empty_list(self):
        self.assertEqual(dedupe([]), [])

    def test_empty_list_result_is_a_list_not_none(self):
        result = dedupe([])
        self.assertIsInstance(result, list)
        self.assertIsNotNone(result)


class DedupeOrderTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_preserves_first_occurrence_order(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            dedupe(["banana", "apple", "cherry", "banana", "apple"]),
            ["banana", "apple", "cherry"],
        )

    def test_preserves_order_across_many_dups(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            dedupe(["c", "a", "b", "a", "c", "b", "a"]),
            ["c", "a", "b"],
        )

    def test_single_element_list(self):
        self.assertEqual(dedupe(["solo"]), ["solo"])

    def test_no_duplicates_unchanged(self):
        self.assertEqual(dedupe(["one", "two", "three"]), ["one", "two", "three"])

    def test_duplicates_of_empty_string(self):
        self.assertEqual(dedupe(["", "", "x", ""]), ["", "x"])

    def test_case_sensitive(self):
        self.assertEqual(dedupe(["A", "a", "A"]), ["A", "a"])

    def test_unicode_strings(self):
        self.assertEqual(dedupe(["h\u00e9llo", "h\u00e9llo", "h3llo"]), ["h\u00e9llo", "h3llo"])


class DedupeValidationTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_non_str_element_raises_value_error(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dedupe(["ok", 1])

    def test_all_non_str_elements_raise_value_error(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dedupe([1, 2, 3])

    def test_str_subclass_is_accepted(self):
        class ColoredStr(str):
            pass

        self.assertEqual(dedupe(["a", ColoredStr("a"), "b"]), ["a", "b"])

    def test_bool_element_raises_value_error(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dedupe(["a", True])

    def test_none_element_raises_value_error(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dedupe(["a", None])

    def test_non_list_input_string_raises_value_error(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dedupe("abc")

    def test_non_list_input_tuple_raises_value_error(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dedupe(("a", "b"))

    def test_non_list_input_none_raises_value_error(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dedupe(None)


class DedupeSideEffectTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_does_not_mutate_input(self):
        original = ["a", "b", "a"]
        dedupe(original)
        self.assertEqual(original, ["a", "b", "a"])

    def test_result_is_a_new_list(self):
        original = ["a", "b", "a"]
        self.assertIsNot(dedupe(original), original)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main(verbosity=2)
